name: axis-lore-sdk
description: Native-fetch TypeScript client for Lore pages and durable memory.

scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('dist/esm',{recursive:true}); require('node:fs').mkdirSync('dist/cjs',{recursive:true}); require('node:fs').writeFileSync('dist/esm/package.json','{\"type\":\"module\"}\n'); require('node:fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json','{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}\n')"
scripts.build:esm: tsc -p tsconfig.json --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --outDir dist/esm --declaration true --declarationDir dist/types
scripts.build:cjs: tsc -p tsconfig.json --module CommonJS --moduleResolution Node --outDir dist/cjs --declaration false
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc tests/client.test.ts --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM --strict --esModuleInterop --types node --rootDir . --outDir dist/test-runner && node --test dist/test-runner/tests/client.test.js
